differences: The adapter preserves the legacy slideshowimages/DPSRI discovery contract and normalizes its timestamp to UTC.
The official API response for the fixture's exact timestamp has the same 480x480 visible pixels and alpha mask as the retained legacy raw; only hidden RGB values under transparent pixels differ.
The provider legend publishes five ordinal rainfall-intensity categories across 33 exact RGB colors. The adapter does not turn these categories into unsupported mm/h or dBZ values.

Transparent pixels within the nominal radius are reported as no displayed rain with BELOW_DETECTION quality, not as a quantitative zero. The source does not disambiguate below-threshold from unobserved returns within range.
Pixel centers outside the nominal 240 km circular range are masked with OUTSIDE quality; an absent slideshow frame remains NoDataError.
The spherical AEQD radius 6,371,000 m is inferred from the provider's EPSG:4326 boundary box and is recorded as an inference.
evidence: official NEA data.gov.sg radar API specification, retrieved 2026-09-21
live matching-frame API comparison on 2026-09-21; signed image URL was not retained
scientific_limits: Rainfall intensity is an ordinal class only; no numeric rain rate is supported by the published color legend.
The image cannot distinguish truly dry pixels from below-threshold or unobserved transparent pixels within radar range.
